title: Boundary Control of Two-dimensional Point-Vortex Systems
summary: In this article, we investigate the boundary controllability of finite point-vortex systems in bounded multiply connected planar Lipschitz domains. The controls are applied locally on an arbitrary nonempty relatively open subset of the boundary. Zero incoming vorticity is assumed at the inflow part of the boundary. For time-dependent controls, we prove exact trajectory controllability along arbitrary prescribed collision-free vortex paths remaining away from the boundary. For stationary controls, we prove exact endpoint controllability associated with mutually disjoint real-analytic arcs.…
